summary: At the Abuja commissioning, Obi says Makinde is qualified to be president and urges 2027 contestants to compete on ideas, unity and inclusion — not desperation.

summary: Responding to Yusuf Datti Baba-Ahmed, Obi cites his Anambra record and pledges civility, cut waste, fight corruption, unity, security, health and education.

summary: On his Kogi–Benue–Enugu thank-you tour, the NDC presidential candidate says he is not worried about the result — only that Nigerians protect their votes.

summary: At Madonna University, Okija, Obi tells students he will stay on the ballot, urges PVC collection, and says he is contesting as the most qualified — not because he is Igbo.

title: Obi in Kogi: elect leaders of capacity, character and compassion
summary: In Ogugu, Olamaboro LGA, Obi and NDC candidates urge free, fair elections and say votes must count. He highlights insecurity, unemployment and food insecurity in rural communities.

title: 2027: Expose any wrongdoing in my past — Peter Obi challenges Nigerians
summary: At Obi Talks Nigeria in Port Harcourt, Obi and running mate Kwankwaso put their records up for public verification and dare anyone with evidence of wrongdoing to speak now.

title: 2027: I am equally ready to die in the fight to rescue Nigeria — Peter Obi
summary: At the Port Harcourt town hall, Obi tells supporters not to be intimidated and to defend the vote: ‘Somebody said we are ready to die. I’m equally ready to die.’

title: We will not arrest you — Peter Obi replies Wike at Port Harcourt town hall
